entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel worshipped on Innistrad, whose absence leaves the people without protection; her churches are patrolled by cats.

entities.name: Radulf
entities.description: A priest of Avacyn who speaks of her light and the hope it offers.

entities.name: Olgard of the Skiltfolk
entities.description: A member of the Skiltfolk who speaks of strong wards on a door and of keeping watch.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A Knight-Cathar who defends Thraben against the unhallowed horde.

entities.name: Bishop Argust
entities.description: A bishop who speaks of heresy and pressing concerns.

entities.name: Constable Visil
entities.description: A constable who tells Thalia he trusts himself to do his duty even unto death.

entities.name: Vonn
entities.description: A geist-trapper who recalls the chill put in his heart by a niblis.

entities.name: Old Rutstein
entities.description: A man who speaks of an unopened bottle and of Kruin Pass.

entities.name: Saint Raban
entities.description: A saint whose tomb inscription asks angels to carry a man into the Blessed Sleep.

entities.name: Cosper Lowe
entities.description: A member of the Silbern Guard who calls valor a currency of the living.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: A necro-alchemist.

entities.name: Captain Eberhart
entities.description: A captain who warns of hungry geists in the waters off the seagrafs.

entities.name: Manfried Ulmach
entities.description: Elgaud Master-at-Arms who warns of the cliff road and the sky.

entities.name: Eruth of Lambholt
entities.description: A person of Lambholt who asks where Flight Alabaster and Avacyn are.

entities.name: Flight Alabaster
entities.description: A flight of angels that once led the dead home.

entities.name: Amalric of Midvast Hall
entities.description: A speaker who says the veil between the living and the dead is thin.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: A stitcher who instructs on injecting viscus vitae, and brother of Gisa.

entities.name: Jenrik
entities.description: Owner of a tower served by geists of those who tried to enter uninvited.

entities.name: Odila
entities.description: A witch of Morkrut who casts a curse of thirst.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: A ghoulcaller of Gavony and sister of Geralf.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker and necromancer who boasts of her power over Innistrad's ghoulcallers.

entities.name: Grafdigger Wulmer
entities.description: A grafdigger who speaks of the dead sleeping lightly and of his cages.

entities.name: Aldreg
entities.description: A Skirsdag cultist.

entities.name: Minaldra, the Vizag Atum
entities.description: A speaker who prophesies dark days and threatens to scorch fields.

entities.name: Rem Karolus
aliases: Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors
entities.description: Blade of the Inquisitors who warns of demons behind devils.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: A master who gathers the howlpack for the Hunter's Moon.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire who speaks of wolves bred to detest the scent of ghouls on her estates.

entities.name: Alena
entities.description: A trapper of Kessig who speaks of wolves and werewolves.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker hunter who challenges Liliana Vess.

entities.name: Halana of Ulvenwald
entities.description: A person of Ulvenwald who speaks of nature wasting nothing, even vampire corpses.

entities.name: Otto the Hunter
entities.description: A hunter full of grand ambitions who was swallowed by a snake.

entities.name: Runo Stromkirk
entities.description: A vampire who orders his people to slay all who trespass.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker and vampire who speaks of his creation, the archangel, keeping the world in balance.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane beset by ghouls, werewolves, vampires and devils in Avacyn's absence.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: A city defended against the unhallowed, home of Thalia and site of the cathedral.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: The cathedral infiltrated by devils at its lower levels.

entities.name: Hollowhenge
entities.description: A place whose murdered inhabitants return as spirits.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: A region of Innistrad, home of Gisa.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A region of Innistrad whose people turned to pagan rituals.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A region home to the skifsang seafarers.

entities.name: Erdwal
entities.description: A network of alleys, sewers and passageways home to savage vampires.

entities.name: Kruin Pass
entities.description: A pass whose travelers are caught in races for their lives.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: A forest that makes no allowances for youth.

entities.name: Somberwald
entities.description: A forest ruled by a dryad.

entities.name: House of Galan
entities.description: A house that takes the most scholarly approach to the mystic traditions and has resorted to more primitive methods in Avacyn's absence.

entities.name: Skiltfolk
entities.description: A folk of Innistrad to which Olgard belongs.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: A cult whose initiates take a vow of blindness and obey only demonkind.

entities.name: Silbern Guard
entities.description: A guard to which Cosper Lowe belongs.

entities.name: Skifsang
entities.description: Seafarers of Nephalia who craft spells like nets.

entities.name: House Markov
entities.description: A vampire house whose chosen and servants are grateful for its favor.

entities.name: Falkenrath
entities.description: A vampire bloodline with torturers and aristocrats.

entities.name: Stromkirk
entities.description: A vampire bloodline led by Runo Stromkirk.

entities.name: Inquisitors
entities.description: The order of which Rem Karolus is Blade.

events.summary: Thalia orders others to grab axes and defend the gate against despair.
events.quote: Grab an axe and defend the gate!

events.summary: Thalia declares she will not see Thraben fall to the unhallowed horde.
events.quote: Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde.

events.summary: Constable Visil confesses to Thalia his fear of what comes after death, and Thalia reassures him of Avacyn's protection.
events.quote: Your soul is protected by the hand of Avacyn and will never submit to evil.

events.summary: Gisa throws bones at her brother Geralf, calling to him.
events.quote: Here are some bones for you to choke on, dear brother!

events.summary: Gisa refuses the Blessed Sleep and wakes the dead to work.
events.quote: Wake up my lovelies, there's work to be done!

events.summary: Liliana Vess boasts that she can create more than Innistrad's ghoulcallers.
events.quote: let me show you what someone with real power can create.

events.summary: Garruk Wildspeaker confronts Liliana Vess, vowing she cannot hide on the dark plane.
events.quote: I have taken down countless night hunters and this dark plane is not big enough for you to hide.

events.summary: Sorin Markov laments that only the shadow of his creation, the archangel, remains.
Runo Stromkirk orders his vampires to slay all who trespass against the humans slaughtered by ghouls.
A shaman calls Tovolar to gather the howlpack for the Hunter's Moon as Thraben's walls weaken.
events.quote: Gather the howlpack, for the Hunter's Moon is nigh and Thraben's walls grow weak.

events.summary: Devils infiltrate the lower levels of Thraben Cathedral, cracking pillars and burning archives.
events.quote: Devils infiltrated the lower levels of Thraben Cathedral, making cracks in load-bearing pillars and setting fire to precious archives.

events.summary: Otto the Hunter is swallowed by a snake.
events.quote: Otto the Hunter was filled with many grand ambitions.

relations.note: Radulf is a priest of Avacyn.
relations.quote: This is the light of Avacyn.

relations.note: Thalia reassures and speaks with Visil.
Gisa calls Geralf her dear brother.
relations.quote: Here are some bones for you to choke on, dear brother!

relations.note: Garruk hunts Liliana as a deathmage.
relations.quote: Your veil's curse won't stop me, deathmage.

relations.note: Runo gives orders to the Stromkirk vampires.
relations.quote: No longer can we allow our human populations to be mindlessly slaughtered by ghouls.

relations.note: Rem Karolus is Blade of the Inquisitors.
relations.quote: Behind every devil's mayhem lurks a demon's scheme.
